result: {"ratings": {"Maya": {"rating": 4, "familiarity": "closely", "why": "Maya cleared the stray drop below the tail, caught the leaning upright and the overshoot on the top arm, and stayed off other people's patches when asked, which kept the table from knocking each other's work."}, "Priya": {"rating": 4, "familiarity": "closely", "why": "Priya set the fish plan and sketched the pad, relaid the belly line and extended the low arm, and kept the top corner join going when it kept failing, though that corner stayed open late and it cost us time."}, "Leo": {"rating": 3, "familiarity": "closely", "why": "Leo was good at flagging gaps and owned up quickly to lifting eight dominoes of my low arm by mistake, and his nudge on the kink helped, but he did less building than the others and that lifting cost us a patch to repair."}}}
